list: The official 55 trophies as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles, 18 November 2026: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden on PlayStation until earned.
note: Names and descriptions are the official ones as PlayStation publishes them. Every guide is written in this guide's own words from the cited sources; the game released 19 November 2026, so a few methods are still unconfirmed and are marked as such.

trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are done — there is no separate task. Work the roadmap in order: story first, then the 100% checklist, then cleanup. PowerPyx rates the whole set 4/10 in difficulty and about 200 hours, with a single playthrough enough and no online trophies.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1 — it is the first mission of the game and the trophy pops as soon as it ends.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Play through Chapter 1; the trophy lands as Chapter 2 opens, after its first mission, What's in the Bag?.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish Chapter 2; the trophy lands as Chapter 3 opens, after its first mission, Welcome to Vice City.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish Chapter 3; the trophy lands early in Chapter 4, after its first two missions, Ocean Beach and Another Life.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Finish Chapter 4; the trophy lands after the chapter's final mission, Starting From Zero.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the final mission of the story — PowerPyx places the pop at the end of the story, after Starting From Zero. Keep a manual save from just before the finale anyway: with no mission replay, it is the one story beat worth a spare save slot.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 2; it pops automatically when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the mission The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3; it pops automatically when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the mission Child's Play in Chapter 4; it pops automatically when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the mission Headliners in Chapter 4; it pops automatically when the mission ends.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the mission VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4; it pops automatically when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5; it pops automatically when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion — the hardest trophy in the set, and the one that decides the platinum. The checklist unlocks after the story under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, but progress made during the story already counts. It is lenient, roughly 60% true completion per PowerPyx: most side quests are not needed and collectibles only partly. The big asks are 70 of 80 challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 300 stunts, all robberies, all shooting ranges, all drone races and all of Bret's quests. Nothing on the checklist is missable, and everything is doable in free-roam after the story.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts across Leonida: 130 stunt jumps over ramps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps with a parachute. Mix the categories freely — PowerPyx calls the under-bridge runs the quickest. Track progress by region under Progress > Activities > Stunts, and on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots, where each stunt keeps its own name and marker. The 100% checklist wants 300 stunts, so keep going past this one.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Check Progress > Activities to see which types you have done. Most come naturally from the story and from chasing the other trophies, so do not grind it — check the counter late and mop up whatever is left.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread over 12 range locations. The golds are not too hard per PowerPyx, and range time also raises your Focus level, which helps Gunslinger later. All 42 are needed for the 100% checklist too, so this is a main-road trophy, not a side quest.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations — 42 drone races in total. A win at each location is what counts, not every race. All locations are also needed for the 100% checklist, and a drone-race win counts as one of the 9 activity types for Master of None.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. There are 40 unique race locations across Leonida, so you only need to win half of them. Race wins also feed Master of None, and the drone races you win for Top Fun count toward the racing habit too.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he texts you a fishing spot marked with a purple icon on the map. Follow his fishing questline from there and beat him at his own challenge.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Four games exist — Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind, all playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1, and Bang For Your Buck on arcade machines around the world. Finish all the levels of any one of them; you need not beat every challenge. Pick whichever you like best.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. This is a Lucia-only questline, marked in Chapter 3: Andy calls, then texts her home address in Belville. Five quests make up the strand — Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass. All of them stay available after the story.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. His questline is marked in Chapter 1 after the mission Island Dreams: Kenton calls, then the green KR icon appears in Key Lento. He marks shipwrecks with purple treasure-chest icons — dive down, use the metal detector to dig the treasure out of the ocean floor, and bring it back. Seven shipwrecks in total. Kenton goes quiet for a while after Chapter 1 but comes back in Chapters 2–3, so nothing here is missable. Track it under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees and Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. His questline is marked after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Five quests make up the strand — Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes. All of them stay available after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Only certain questlines count toward this one — Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not. The strands PowerPyx confirms as counting are Kirk (the Skunk Ape quests), Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete. Check the trophy counter in the trophy list to see how many you have done, and keep playing strangers after the story: every one of them stays available in free-roam.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. After the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS you unlock the Key Cloner and deliver a Zorrusso to Randy; he then hands you a wish list of 16 sports cars to steal and deliver to his garage (green RK icon, west Vice City). Scan cars with the WAiNK app to check them against the list, and deliver them in good condition for more money — high-end cars cluster around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach. Track the list under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List. It can all be done after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. This is a Jason-only questline, marked after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Purple markers point you to the Synthetic Labs around Vice City — go and destroy them (quest: Take Out Kitty Litter). Once enough labs are down, Tyrone offers the second quest, Spin On This, which pops the trophy. All of it stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots in 10 locations. Meditating with both Jason and Lucia at the same spot counts as +2, and you cannot finish the last one until both characters can play together, after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. Track it under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. THIS IS THE ONLY POTENTIALLY MISSABLE TROPHY: one meditation happens only in Chapter 1 at Jason's house — the morning after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia talks about meditating in the kitchen, then walks out to the balcony; follow her and accept. PowerPyx notes it is not yet confirmed whether that one counts toward the trophy, so do it to be safe. For the 100% checklist only 15 of 18 meditations are needed.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret Vogel's Jason-only questline is marked after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break — a text from Bret marks his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County. He then marks hunting spots with purple icons; hunt the animals he asks for and bring them back to him as Jason. His first quest gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nation. Track it under Map > Activities > Target Deck; all 15 Target Decks are needed for 100% anyway, so this pops on the way.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. There are 18 card set locations across Leonida, and any 3 complete sets will do — you do not need them all. PowerPyx's card guide maps every set, so pick the three closest together and work outward.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations: hold Up, then R1, to scan landmarks, curiosities and sculptures in the world. Known totals are 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher tags — far more than the 100 you need, so any 100 scans count. Scanning is the same habit that feeds Whip It Good, so do both together.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. There are 80 in total and you only need 50 here — 70 for the 100% checklist — so skip the hardest ones. Track them under Progress > Challenges, where a checkmark shows what is done. Most complete naturally while you chase the other trophies; save this for late, then pick off the easiest ones that remain.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. Only possible after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when Jason and Lucia can roam together — call your partner with Right + Triangle. Build 4 stars however you like, then break out of the red heat zone: the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is an easy escape, since the helicopter cannot see you on the tracks. It also pops naturally while robbing the large bank vaults in Chapter 4, which always trigger 4 stars.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Call your partner, then hit 3 robbery targets (green map icons) while the wanted level keeps flashing — stay in the blue/red search state, not the red heat state. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and healing (Zombix or Adrenaline). The 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City, open after Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, are a good spot: loot a couple of items in each and crack the back-room safe. The pop is delayed about half a minute after leaving the third shop — hit a fourth shop if it does not come.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Open the WAiNK app from your phone (hold Up for instant access) and scan vehicles with R1 — stand on a busy road and scan everything that passes. You only need to scan them, not drive them. The 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models, so this pops on the way. Track what you have found under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger it with L3+R3 while aiming: time slows and weak spots are highlighted, draining the purple focus bar. Buff focus first — eat, drink, wash up — and pop Adrenaline to stretch the slow-mo; wear body armor and use an accurate full-auto rifle like the Duke 556 on a group of gang enemies. It does not seem to count against soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels (check Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Focus) and grows through shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, so it gets easier late in the game.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal — the one at terminals E3/E4 is easiest. Drive through a fence onto the airfield, take the stairs by the boarding bridge straight into the plane, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the strip and take off. Fly at least 1 km away from the airport for the pop. Planes parked out on the airfield do not count — it has to be one docked to a terminal.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank. The Rhinos stand in the south of Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. Drive through the gate — or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance — climb into a tank and start shooting until the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which unlocks the Snap Gun and marks jewelry robberies with green icons. Enter through the back door using the Snap Gun instead of kicking it in — kicking trips the alarm. In the back room, find the note with the safe code and loot the safe. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Unlock them with the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… — tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open (bring your partner to carry a second bag of cash). After that, buy security-van tips from Yasmani for $10,000 a tip, once you have done his earlier Payday Loans jobs. Each vault pays up to $205,000 and instantly triggers a 4-star wanted level — a fast motorcycle and a quick vehicle swap help you vanish. All 8 large bank jobs are needed for 100%, so this pops on the way.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. It pops automatically during the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is…, since robbing a bank vault counts as robbing the armored truck that delivered the cash. An earlier method: watch for armored trucks driving near banks in Vice City, block one's path, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open — then escape the red heat radius. Sticky bombs are sold at the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests, and Yasmani becomes a fence after Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — fully unfog the map across all 52 areas. The fastest way is from the air: take a plane and fly over every black-fogged patch until the whole map is visible. It pairs well with the stunt flying for Cunning Stunts.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 gang operations in total — all of them are needed for 100% — but one per gang is enough here. They show as yellow icons when you get near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. Track each gang under Progress > Gangs, where the count of robbed operations is shown per gang.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The method is not yet confirmed at launch — PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, and no guide has pinned down the exact spot or trigger yet. This guide will be updated once a source confirms it; do not trust any method that cites no source.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley: steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations. The luxury watch sits in the south-east office, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun lies on a table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway needs sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation to crack. The optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling marks it in Chapter 2. The trophy pops after you escape the police — and you need not grab all three in one visit, since the robbery icon respawns after a while, so it is not missable.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal: reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Only possible after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Work out together — buy a fitness club membership, call your partner along (Right + Triangle), and while one character trains the other progresses too, so you make double progress. Check strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength (heart icon). Gyms are filterable on the map under Activities, and you can also work out at home after the story.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. Turn on criminal-profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile) and watch for the demon-face icon whenever an action counts. Clean stealth work counts as Professional, non-lethal takedowns as Hardened, killing as Violent, mass killing as Psycho — and Irredeemable is permanent, so do not push your violence that far. It accrues passively through robberies and fights on the way to the other trophies; expect police to shoot on sight at the higher profiles.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The method is not yet confirmed at launch — PowerPyx believes it is related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue, but no guide has pinned down the exact trigger yet. This guide will be updated once a source confirms it; do not trust any method that cites no source.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering marked bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer, then rob banks and Payday Loans and carry the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 is cumulative across all trips, not in one go; bank vaults pay up to $205,000 per robbery, so it comes naturally while doing the 100% robberies.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — the total is cumulative across every shop type. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the priciest, so Ammu-Nation and mod shops move the counter fastest. It pops naturally while gearing up for the other trophies.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties (the 4 story-related garages do not count). They cost $160,000 in total and go on sale after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, when the Vice City Real Estate app lands on your phone — buy them through the app. Robberies, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3–4, are the fastest way to fund them. Garages also add the parking spots you need for On the Spot.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses, and lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to you anywhere. You need garage space first (see Little Boxes) — each garage adds parking spots. Drive a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn, choose Respray then Register; from Chapter 3, cars with standard trackers can also be registered at any Pay 'n' Spray. Moses only takes tracker-free vehicles at first, and registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
trophies.name: On the Spot
